Before making another to-do list: where will you actually see it?  Trace lets you choose what goes on your iPhone Lock Screen wallpaper. First slide: the settings. Second: the layout.  Would you put your week or just today’s plans there?

Melbourne people: how long can “we should grab a coffee” stay in the chat before it legally becomes a pen pal situation? 😂  Pick a day. Pick a café. Put it in the calendar. Trace lets you type the plan in plain language, then check and save it.  What’s your go-to spot for a first coffee catch-up?

“I’ll sort it on Friday.”  Friday would like to know who approved this workload.  If opening your planner is another thing to remember, put the plan where you already look. Trace can show your calendar and to-dos on your iPhone Lock Screen wallpaper.  What’s the one thing future-you needs to see this week?

Jadwal berubah, kalendernya belum diubah. Relate? 🥲  Di Trace, kamu bisa minta perubahan jadwal lewat kalimat biasa. Cek tanggal dan jamnya dulu sebelum disimpan.  Yang paling sering geser: meeting, kelas, atau janji pribadi?

Warga Bandung, ada rekomendasi komunitas yang ramah buat pemula? Buat yang pengen ikut kelas, jalan pagi, atau belajar bareng.  Jangan sampai rekomendasinya cuma numpuk di simpanan 😭  Kalau udah nemu jadwal yang cocok, tulis di Trace pakai bahasa sehari-hari, cek drafnya, lalu simpan.  Rekomendasi satu dong. Kegiatan apa, di mana, biasanya hari apa?

Kerja jalan. Usaha jalan. Konten jalan. Olahraga jalan. Yang belum jalan: mulai satu-satu 🫠  Kalau target udah numpuk, coba pilih tiga tugas kecil dulu. Di Matrix Trace, kamu bisa bagi sendiri mana yang penting dan mendesak, mana yang bisa dijadwalkan.  Hari ini, satu hal apa yang pengen kamu beresin dulu?

Reminder dah swipe, lepas tu terus lupa? 🥲  Trace boleh letak jadual dan to-do pada wallpaper Lock Screen iPhone. Swipe gambar kedua untuk tengok tetapan dalam app.  Korang lebih perlukan jadual atau to-do dekat situ?

POV: lagi 10 hari nak majlis. Vendor dah confirm. Dalam kepala masih ada 37 tab terbuka 😭  Yang dah kahwin, benda kecil apa paling senang terlepas pandang?  Dalam Trace, boleh susun checklist sendiri ikut penting dan urgent. Mula dengan yang betul-betul kena settle hari ni. Baki tu, bincang siapa urus apa. Jangan simpan semua dalam kepala seorang.

POV: itinerary Jepun 18 hari siap cantik dalam Excel. Tukar satu booking, kena cari balik screenshot, chat, email… penat dia lain macam 😂  Dalam Trace, boleh taip perubahan jadual guna bahasa biasa. Semak draf tu, baru simpan.  Korang jenis plan sampai minit, atau satu hari satu tempat pun dah cukup?

Nasa calendar na yung deadline. Pero kailan mo gagawin yung task? 🥲  Sa Trace, may calendar para sa oras at task list para sa kailangang gawin.  Ikaw, deadline lang ba nilalagay mo o pati oras para gawin yung task?

Ang sarap basahin ng “finally, passed!” posts. Pero bago ’yung result, may review after work, practice questions, at mga araw na pagod ka na talaga.  Sa Trace, puwedeng i-type ang study schedule, i-check, then save. Kahit isang realistic review block muna.  Sa working reviewees: anong oras kayo nakakasingit ng aral?

Naka-save ang duty roster sa photos. Ang dental appointment nasa chat. Ang “day off ko ba ’to?” nasa prayers na lang 😭  Trace can show your calendar and to-dos on your iPhone Lock Screen wallpaper, para isang tingin bago mag-yes sa lakad.  Sa shifting schedule: saan kayo tumitingin bago gumawa ng plans?

A work schedule screenshot is not a calendar entry yet.  Trace can turn schedule images into drafts, so you can check the dates and times before adding them.  What do you keep retyping: shifts, classes, or appointments?

Buying the 2027 planner: a whole personality. Opening the planner: apparently a separate hobby.  For anyone who needs the plan somewhere they’ll actually see it: Trace puts your calendar and to-dos on your iPhone Lock Screen wallpaper.  Be honest. How many mostly blank planners are in your house?

Family photos are not one task.  They’re outfits, laundry, haircuts, snacks, booking the slot… and someone remembering all of it.  Before adding another reminder, agree on who owns each job. Then use Trace’s Matrix to sort your own tasks by importance and urgency.  What’s the invisible prep job everyone forgets to count?

The task that shouts loudest isn’t always the most important.  Trace has a Matrix view for sorting tasks by urgency and importance. You choose what goes where.  What’s the important thing you keep putting off?

How does half-term manage to sneak up on us when it’s been on the school website all year? 🫠  The dates are in an email. The club times are in a screenshot. The inset day is… somewhere.  Trace can turn a timetable image into a calendar draft. Check it against your own school’s dates before saving.  Where does your school send the bit you always miss?

Lovely organised screen. Seventeen things marked urgent. Still no idea what to start with.  Trace’s Matrix lets you sort tasks by importance and urgency. Try putting just three things in it first, including the important one that never shouts.  What’s been sitting on your list because everything else is “urgent”?
